content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've encountered several issues installing [product_name] engineering software on my old laptop. After much troubleshooting, it turned out the laptop wasn't suitable. I bought a new laptop and successfully installed [product_name] engineering software, but now I'm unable to install [product_name] application. The installer runs to completion but then a message appears stating: 'This application has unexpectedly quit. Invocation of this Java application caused an invocation target exception. This application will now quit.' Can anyone offer advice? Thank you in advance.
Which operating system are you using? Did you run the [product_name] installation as an administrator?
I'm using Windows 8 and installing as admin.
Which [product_name] software version are you using? For versions older than [version_no], please refer to this FAQ: [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users face critical installation errors while installing [product_name] on a Windows 8 laptop, despite successful installation of related engineering software and using administrator privileges. The main problem is an unexpected software shutdown involving a Java exception, suggesting compatibility issues between the software version and the operating system. Users are uncertain about required software versions and compatibility measures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to install smoothly on Windows 8 machines, assuming that administrator rights and upgraded hardware ensure compatibility and trouble-free setup.
